description: Record the verdict on one page of a shift. mode "book-run" (start_review_shift / continue_review_shift): the verdict and findings are YOURS, from reading the scan and both texts; set user_looked true if the user checked anything on the page themselves. mode "blind" (start_blind_check): the verdict is the USER'S, given before your reading; put yours in assistant_verdict. Verdicts: both_sound (transcription matches the scan and the English matches the original), translation_drift (transcription right, English departs from it), transcription_off (the text does not match the scan), both_off, unclear (the scan or the text cannot be judged). Quote exact words in every finding. A review is evidence about the page; it does not change it.

assistant_findings.description: Problems found, each with an exact quote (max 12).

problem.description: What is wrong, and what the scan or original shows (max 500 chars)

quote.description: The exact words at issue (max 300 chars)

user_agreed.description: Only if the user actually weighed in on this point

assistant_model.description: Your own model name and version, copied exactly as your instructions or system prompt give it, and whether extended thinking is on. Write "unknown" rather than guess; a wrong name is worse than none.

assistant_verdict.description: Your own verdict (blind mode; in book-run it equals verdict).

first_verdict.description: blind: the user's verdict before your reading, if it changed.

item_id.description: page.item_id (book run) or the item's item_id (blind check)

mode.description: "book-run" unless the page came from start_blind_check.

name.description: How the user wants to be credited (optional).

note.description: Anything a later reader should know (optional, max 2000 chars).

reader_languages.description: Languages the user says they read, if they said.

user_looked.description: book-run: true if the user checked something on this page themselves.

verdict.description: book-run: your verdict. blind: the user's final verdict.

verdict_before_assistant.description: blind: true if the user committed to a verdict before seeing your reading.

name: submit_page_review
title: Submit a Page Review
